adverse_cost Sharpe > 0

adverse_cost target fingerprint == base_execution target fingerprint
all two preregistered candidate outputs are reported

payload.selection_metric: No winner selection. Mechanically evaluate the preregistered component gates on adverse_cost relative to base_execution.

Full G5 remains PENDING/PARTIAL until the separately frozen +1 execution-session delay stress is executed in the same Swift engine; this result alone must not be described as full G5 PASS.

The delay changes only execution timing; it must not change the source V11 target path or introduce a new strategy rule.

delay0 control CAGR must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.01 percentage points
delay0 control MDD must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.01 percentage points
delay0 control Sharpe must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.001

payload.swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_v11_execution_delay_stress.py -> tools/v11_execution_delay_stress.swiftpart -> BacktestEngine.runAdvancedRotationStrategyWithTrace (source V11) + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace (fixed target replay) -> shared BacktestDailySimulator

payload.decision: PASS. The delay=0 replay control matched the locked G5-001 adverse-cost result within every preregistered tolerance. Under 1.50% fee + 0.10% slippage plus one additional common BacktestDailySimulator session of execution delay, CAGR remained positive at 12.648191%, Sharpe remained positive at 1.347129, and MDD was 8.369464%, below the frozen 15.378108% limit. All 166 source rebalance events were replayed with configured_delay_sessions=1, with the same source rebalance-date sequence. Together with the already locked G5-001 cost-component PASS, this mechanically sets full G5 execution robustness to PASS. No delay2/3 or alternative cost level may be searched for V11 on this dataset.

payload.decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED. HR-A higher-frequency multi-timescale trend failed severely after costs (CAGR -6.092938%, Sharpe -0.359320, MDD 77.972036%). HR-B risk-budget completion was the strongest new architecture but still failed every primary return/risk admission threshold (CAGR 13.834435%, Sharpe 1.300311, MDD 13.003196%, 4/7 folds Sharpe>1) and underperformed frozen V11 full-history CAGR. HR-C also failed (CAGR 4.464056%, Sharpe 0.447475, MDD 24.021576%). No cadence, band, breadth, horizon or blend-weight rescue search is allowed within this trial.
